grammar: 省略 describes deliberately leaving out wording. The meeting place remains understood because both participants have already agreed on it.

sentence: 弟弟只发来“明天下午在车站见”，我问是三点还是四点；他又补上具体时间：“下午三点，别记错了。”
grammar: 补上 expresses supplying something missing. 上 marks the addition being made; here the added component is the exact meeting time.

sentence: 姐姐发来短信：“我把字典交给小安了，他明天带给你。”这里的“他”指代小安，我明天去找小安取书。
grammar: 指代 connects an expression to its referent. 他 refers back to 小安, the person receiving the dictionary in the message.

sentence: 桌上两箱书合起来一共十本，也就是两箱的总数是十本，不是每箱十本；登记时别写成二十本。
grammar: 也就是 introduces an equivalent explanation. The restatement preserves ten as the combined total rather than assigning ten to each box.
note: 总数 zǒngshù means total number.

sentence: “明天出门的事准备得怎么样了？”“车票的话，我已经买好了；旅馆还没定，姐姐今晚再比较一下。”
grammar: After the noun 车票, 的话 singles out that topic for comment. The reply contrasts settled tickets with unsettled accommodation; it does not propose a hypothetical ticket condition.
register: Conversational topic framing.

sentence: 姐姐说：“周六上午有空，下午要上课。”妈妈问她哪天有空，我按原话转告：“周六上午有空，下午要上课。”
grammar: 原话 names the speaker's original wording. The repeated quotation preserves both the morning availability and the afternoon commitment.

sentence: 小组通知写着：“周五前交表，周六上午答复。”我把原文发给姐姐，提醒她通知只说了答复时间，没有说一定批准。
grammar: 原文 refers to the notice's written wording. A promised reply time does not itself promise approval.

sentence: 姐姐的短信写着：“周六去公园，午饭自己带。”她提到了午饭，但没说带什么；我准备问她要不要一起做三明治。
grammar: 提到 says an item appears in what someone says or writes. Mentioning lunch does not mean its menu has been discussed or settled.
note: 三明治 sānmíngzhì means sandwich.

sentence: 老师的通知写着：“周六去公园读书，雨天改在教室。”我在给姐姐的留言中写：“通知提及雨天的安排，但没说教室在几楼，我再问问。”
grammar: 提及 means mention, alongside 提到. The comment accurately identifies the rain arrangement while leaving the room's floor unspecified.
register: 提及 suits this written description of a notice; 提到 is also natural.

sentence: 我写的活动记录只有两句：“三点大家介绍了自己的书，四点开始登记借书。”这份记录只涉及下午的读书活动，没有说明上午各组做了什么。
grammar: 涉及 takes the subject matter covered by an account. 只 limits this record to the afternoon activity; it supplies no account of the morning.
note: 记录 jìlù means a written record here.

sentence: 这次读书会只有我、姐姐和小安参加，谁都可以先讲，不用按年龄排顺序；最后我们商量好由小安先讲。
meaning: anyone; everyone in the stated group
grammar: 谁 with 都 extends the permission to every member of the stated three-person group. It does not ask for someone's identity.

sentence: 这把锁的钥匙可能拿错了；我们三个人轮流试过，谁也没把门打开，门现在还锁着。
grammar: 谁也 combines with following 没 to deny successful opening for every member of the three-person group. The whole 谁也没 expression means none of them did.

sentence: 妈妈问我要面包、包子还是饺子，我说：“这三样我什么都爱吃，你选一样就好。”
grammar: 什么都 extends 爱吃 across the three named foods. It is a statement of liking, not a question asking what the speaker likes.
note: 样 yàng counts kinds or choices here; 这三样 means these three options.

sentence: 老师最初只说“下午来帮忙”，后来明确了我的任务：“三点在门口登记客人的名字，其他事由小安负责。”
grammar: 明确 takes 我的任务 as its object and describes making the assignment specific. The quotation supplies the time, location and required action.
note: 最初 zuìchū means initially or at first.

sentence: 姐姐只发来“我晚一点来”，说得很含糊：原来约好六点，她是说六点半，还是八点？我得先问清楚，才好安排晚饭。
grammar: 含糊 describes wording that leaves the intended time insufficiently determined. The two possible times show why clarification is needed.
note: The second syllable hu is neutral in this selected reading. 才好安排晚饭 means only then can the speaker suitably arrange dinner.

sentence: 小安发来“姐姐告诉妹妹，她的书找到了”，这里有歧义：“她”可能指姐姐，也可能指妹妹；我先问清楚再转告。
grammar: 歧义 names the availability of different interpretations. Here the possessive 她的 can refer to either of two women already named.

sentence: 老师对我说：“你昨天忘了锁门，以后离开前要检查。”这次批评的对象是我，不是昨天替我锁门的姐姐，我得自己道歉。
meaning: the person an action is directed at
grammar: 对象 names the person toward whom the criticism is directed. It refers to the speaker, not the sister who corrected the omission.

sentence: 老师说：“今天只打扫教室里面，门外的走廊由另一组负责。”这次我们打扫的范围不包括走廊，先把教室里的桌椅摆好。
grammar: 范围 names the area covered by the assigned cleaning. The classroom is included, while the corridor is assigned to another group.
note: 走廊 zǒuláng means corridor.

sentence: 这次聚会的饭菜很好吃，但开始得太晚；在时间安排方面，我建议下次提前半个小时，菜单不用改。
grammar: 方面 follows 时间安排 within 在……方面 and limits the suggestion to scheduling. The food and menu receive a separate positive assessment.

sentence: 从整体看，这次读书会按计划完成了，每个人都介绍了自己的书；只是借书登记慢了一点，最后多等了十分钟。
grammar: 从整体看 assesses the activity as a whole. The following qualification identifies one slower component without extending that problem to every part.

sentence: 这面墙只有门边一小块掉了漆，只要做局部修补，其他地方不用重新刷。
meaning: a limited part; a local area
grammar: 局部 modifies 修补 and limits the repair to the small damaged area. It contrasts with repainting the whole wall.
note: 漆 qī means paint or lacquer; 修补 xiūbǔ means patch or repair.

sentence: 活动室门口的牌子写着：“此处是出入口，请别放箱子，椅子也请搬进屋。”
grammar: 此处 refers to the doorway where the sign is displayed. 处 is read chù in this place expression.
register: 此处 is common in written notices; 这里 is a conversational counterpart.
note: 出入口 chūrùkǒu means entrance and exit.

sentence: 我在搬家记录里写道：“上午十点，搬家的车到了楼下；此时姐姐还在楼上收拾书，我先下去给司机开门。”
meaning: at this moment in the account
grammar: 此时 refers to the ten-o'clock arrival just described. It places the sister's continuing activity at that same moment rather than marking past tense.
register: 此时 suits this written account; 当时 is also common when recalling an event.

sentence: 老师的通知写着：“今天要核对报名表，还要给借来的书登记。上述两件事都由小安负责，其他人收拾教室。”
grammar: 上述 points back to checking forms and registering borrowed books, the two tasks stated immediately before it.
register: Written reference to preceding content.

sentence: 老师给我们发来消息：“请带下列物品到教室：一本自己读过的书、一支笔；其他东西先不用带。”
grammar: 下列 modifies 物品 and directs attention forward to the book and pen listed after the colon.
register: Common in written instructions and lists.
note: 物品 wùpǐn means items or articles.

sentence: 我给家人留言：“明天聚会的分工如下：姐姐做饭，我买饮料，弟弟摆桌子；大家六点一起吃饭。”
grammar: 如下 introduces the actual content that follows. Here the following clauses specify each family member's task.
register: Useful in organized written messages.

sentence: 上课前，旁边的同学说：“我是这门课的新学生，有点紧张。”我说：“我也是，我们一起去找教室吧。”
meaning: am also, with the category understood
grammar: 我也是 leaves 这门课的新学生 understood from the preceding copular statement. 也 applies that same category to the second speaker.

sentence: “我昨天没去读书会，你呢？”“我也没，那时正在家里接待客人；今天一起问问大家读了什么吧。”
meaning: did not either, with the event understood
grammar: 我也没 leaves 去读书会 understood from the first speaker's statement. 没 denies that same event for the second speaker.
register: The shortened response is natural in informal conversation.

sentence: “给客人的通知发出去了吗？”“还没，我正在核对开始时间；等老师确认后再发。”
meaning: not yet, with the event understood
grammar: 还没 answers the completion question with 发出去 understood. Sending remains pending while the starting time is checked.

sentence: 姐姐指着桌上那杯果汁问：“这是给你留的，要不要？”我说：“要，谢谢，正好渴了。”
meaning: do you want it or not?
grammar: 要不要 asks about wanting the identified juice. Its object is understood from the offer; 不要 is the negative alternative rather than a prohibition.
note: The reading retains lexical bù. Before fourth-tone yào, a full-tone connected realization is bú; the middle syllable can also weaken in this question pattern.

sentence: 姐姐约我们周六下午三点到图书馆听林老师介绍新书，我已经答应了；你去不去？请今晚告诉我，我要把人数告诉她。
grammar: 去不去 offers affirmative and negative alternatives for attending the stated library event. The destination and activity need not be repeated.
note: 人数 rénshù means number of people. Lexical bù can surface as bú before fourth-tone qù or weaken in the question pattern.

sentence: “小安今天一点忙也没帮。”“他刚替我们搬完所有椅子，难道这不算帮忙？请别说他没做事。”
grammar: 难道 introduces a challenge to the claim that 小安 did nothing. The completed chair-moving task supports the expected response that it does count as help.

sentence: 昨天你我都在短信里确认三点见。今天你说两点来，我回道：“我们不是约好三点见吗？我两点还在上课，请按原来的时间。”
meaning: marks an appeal for confirmation of an established fact
grammar: In 不是……吗, 吗 helps appeal to the already confirmed arrangement. The speaker expects acknowledgment of three o'clock rather than seeking an unknown meeting time.
note: 回道 huídào means replied, introducing the quoted response.

sentence: “你今天肯定坐过地铁。”“我从早上到现在一直在家，门都没出，怎么会坐过地铁？你记错了。”
meaning: how could, in a rhetorical challenge
grammar: 怎么 before 会 challenges the possibility of the claimed trip. Staying home throughout the stated interval supplies the contradiction; no travel procedure is being requested.

sentence: “门不是我锁的。”“今天只有你我来过，我没锁，而且刚才看见你用钥匙锁门；除了你还能是谁？把钥匙放回盒子里吧。”
meaning: who else, with alternatives rhetorically excluded
grammar: 除了你还能是谁 asks rhetorically for an alternative actor while excluding one through the stated two-person set and eyewitness account. The speaker already identifies the listener as the actor.

sentence: “下午三点到四点，你来帮我整理照片吧。”“我两点到六点都在上课，哪有时间过去？换个时间吧。”
meaning: there is no, in a rhetorical denial
grammar: 哪有时间 denies having time within the requested interval. The class occupies that entire interval, and the request to reschedule confirms the denial rather than a literal location question.

sentence: 地址我已经发到你手机上，你也看到了，何必再跑回来拿纸条？直接去车站等我就行。
meaning: why bother; there is no need to
grammar: 何必 questions the necessity of an action. The address is already available, so the speaker recommends omitting the return trip.
note: 纸条 zhǐtiáo means a slip of paper.

sentence: “我打算把这箱书分四次搬上楼。”“电梯就在旁边，何苦自己来回爬楼？放进电梯，我陪你一起搬。”
meaning: why put yourself through that trouble
grammar: 何苦 questions taking on avoidable hardship. The offer to help and the available lift make the response sympathetic.
note: 电梯 diàntī means lift or elevator; 来回 láihuí means back and forth.

sentence: “我们先把客人的饭吃了。”“客人还没到，饭又只够他们吃，哪能先吃？再等十分钟。”
grammar: 哪能 rejects the proposed action as unacceptable in this situation. The objection concerns eating the guests' limited food before they arrive.

sentence: “这张收据的照片已经存好了，字也很清楚。”“那你再抄一遍干什么？不用抄，明天把照片给老师看就行。”
meaning: what for, when no useful purpose is apparent
grammar: After the proposed action, 干什么 challenges its purpose. The saved, legible photograph makes copying unnecessary.
note: 抄 chāo means copy by hand. 干 is gàn for doing an action here.

sentence: “六个杯子要洗，我怕来不及。”“不就是洗六个杯子吗？我洗，你擦，五分钟就能收好，不用着急。”
meaning: isn't it just, minimizing the difficulty
grammar: 不就 participates in 不就是……吗, presenting the task as limited and manageable. The proposed division of work supports that assessment.
note: In connected speech, 不 normally becomes bú before fourth-tone jiù; the reading retains lexical bù.

sentence: “老师同意明天借教室吗？”“他刚当着我们两个人说‘同意’，还用问吗？我现在去登记。”
meaning: still need to, rhetorically denying the need
grammar: 还用 before 问 challenges the need to ask again. Both participants have just heard the teacher's explicit agreement; 用 expresses necessity here.
note: 当着 dāngzhe means in someone's presence.

sentence: “姐姐回来陪你过生日了，你高兴吗？”“我本来以为今年得一个人过，能不高兴吗？我真想马上见到她！”
grammar: 能不……吗 expects an affirmative interpretation here: the speaker is pleased. The unexpected companionship and wish to meet the sister establish that reaction.

sentence: “只剩一把小椅子，我们两个人怎么坐？”“再借一把，难不成两个人都挤在这一把上？我去问邻居。”
grammar: 难不成 introduces an implausible alternative that the speaker rejects in favor of borrowing another chair.
register: A conversational rhetorical alternative to 难道.

sentence: “你怎么一上午都在擦地？”“还不是弟弟把整盆水打翻了！水流到每个角落，我只好一块一块擦。”
meaning: it's because, presenting the explanation emphatically
grammar: 还不是 introduces the actual explanation with a complaining tone. It affirms that the spill caused the prolonged cleaning rather than denying the spill.
note: In connected speech, 不 normally becomes bú before fourth-tone shì; the reading retains lexical bù.

sentence: “老师把钥匙收进哪个抽屉了？你快告诉我。”“他收钥匙时我已经回家，我哪儿知道？你直接问他。”
meaning: how would I, rhetorically denying knowledge
grammar: 哪儿 before 知道 rejects the assumption that the speaker has the information. The speaker had already left and directs the question to the teacher.
note: nǎr represents the rhotic reading as one syllable.

sentence: “我们说好让爷爷休息，可箱子这么多，还是叫他来帮忙？”“我们两个又不是搬不动，何不每人少拿一点，分两次搬？别再打扰爷爷。”
grammar: 何不 recommends the following action. Carrying smaller loads in two trips preserves the agreement to let the grandfather rest.

sentence: “我不想等小安了，先走，不通知他。”“我们答应一起走，怎么能把他一个人留在这里？至少先联系他，商量清楚。”
grammar: 怎么能 challenges the proposal as inconsistent with a promise. It does not ask whether leaving is physically possible.

sentence: “我已经把每个名字都核对过，肯定没错。”“这里同一个人写了两次，你还说没错？先把多写的那个删掉，再确认总数。”
grammar: 还说 presents continued assertion as unjustified after the duplicate entry is pointed out. The reply challenges the claim rather than adding another thing to say.

sentence: “我们组没人会修椅子。”“谁说没人会？小安刚修好两把，坐着都很稳；下次先问问他。”
grammar: 谁说 rejects the immediately preceding claim. The successful repairs provide a counterexample; the speaker is not seeking the claimant's name.

sentence: “我把借书日期写错了一天，怕老师笑我，不敢去改。”“有什么好怕的？老师说过，发现错了随时来改；我们现在就去。”
meaning: what grounds are there, rhetorically minimizing concern
grammar: 有什么好怕的 questions whether there are grounds for fear. The teacher's explicit invitation to correct errors supports the reassurance.
note: 随时 suíshí means at any time.

sentence: “今天别去公园了，在家读书。”“我还是想去公园，不过你不想出门，好吧，今天听你的，我留下读书。”
grammar: 好吧 accepts the proposed arrangement despite the speaker's stated preference for going out. The following commitment confirms the assent.

sentence: “我得去接孩子，可这两把椅子还没搬。”“你先走吧，椅子我来搬，别让孩子等久了。”
meaning: softens a directive to the listener
grammar: 吧 makes 你先走 a less abrupt directive to one listener. The speaker takes over the remaining work so the listener can collect the child.

sentence: 周六这次聚会，去吧，又得请假；不去，我又很想见老同学，到现在还没决定。
grammar: 吧 follows 去 as the speaker weighs that option and its drawback. The contrasting 不去 clause supplies the other side of the unresolved dilemma.

sentence: “这把椅子很便宜。”“便宜就便宜吧，可它一坐就晃，我不想买回去再修。”
meaning: concedes a point without accepting its implication
grammar: 便宜就便宜吧 provisionally grants the price assessment. The speaker still rejects buying the unstable chair, so conceding the point does not settle the choice.

sentence: “今天搬书真累。”“可不是，我们从早上搬到中午，连喝水都没空。”
meaning: exactly; you can say that again
grammar: 可不是 emphatically agrees with the preceding assessment. The shared morning of work reinforces the agreement despite the expression's negative-looking form.
register: Conversational emphatic agreement.
note: The middle syllable bu is neutral in this selected lexical reading.

sentence: “旧电脑也要五千元吗？”“不用，这台便宜着呢，只卖五百元，写作业够用。”
grammar: 着呢 after 便宜 emphasizes how inexpensive the computer is relative to the stated expectation. It does not mark an action in progress.
note: Both syllables are neutral-tone here.

sentence: “小安肯定不愿意帮忙。”“他刚主动问还有什么要做，你怎么能说他不愿意呢？先听他自己说。”
grammar: 呢 reinforces the challenging question and the speaker's objection. The reported offer of help contradicts the claim of unwillingness; no continuing activity is asserted by 呢.

sentence: “周六我们都有空，公园和图书馆也都开门；你想去公园散步，还是去图书馆看书呢？”“我想看书，就去图书馆。”
grammar: Final 呢 gives the explicit 还是 alternatives a deliberative, answer-seeking tone. The reply selects the library; this is a genuine choice question.

sentence: “你明早六点能来接我吗？”“能，我已经把闹钟调到五点半，明早会准时到的。”
grammar: Final 的 reinforces the speaker's assurance about their own promised arrival. It does not connect a modifier to a noun.
note: 闹钟 nàozhōng means alarm clock.

sentence: “小安三点准时到，放心。”“现在三点了，他刚说坐车还要半个小时，能准时到才怪！我们先进去等。”
grammar: 才怪 rejects the proposition before it. The meeting time has arrived while the remaining journey still takes half an hour.
register: A blunt colloquial dismissal that can sound confrontational.

sentence: “为什么只给小安留了水果，没有蛋糕？”“你我都知道他不吃鸡蛋嘛，这个蛋糕里有鸡蛋；水果是给他准备的。”
meaning: appeals to shared information as a reason
grammar: 嘛 presents the explicitly shared knowledge as a reason for the food arrangement. It does not make the clause a yes/no question.

sentence: 早上我告诉弟弟：“纸盒先留着，晚上装书。”晚上他说已经扔掉，我说：“我不是早就说过先留着嘛！现在又得找盒子。”
grammar: 嘛 invokes the earlier instruction as something the listener should remember. The discarded box and renewed search establish the speaker's complaint.

sentence: “周末来我家吃饭。”“我怕打扰你，还是不去了。”“来嘛，我已经多准备了一份，正想和你聊聊。”
grammar: 嘛 makes the repeated invitation coaxing after the guest's hesitation. The extra portion and wish to chat support the personal appeal.

sentence: “本子找不到了，可我现在得记下这个地址。”“先记在手机里呗，你手机就在手边，晚点找到本子再抄。”
grammar: 呗 presents recording the address on the available phone as an easy practical solution. It is not a general replacement for every use of 吧.
note: 手边 shǒubiān means close at hand. 呗 is neutral-tone bei here.

sentence: “我真想去公园，可外面一直下雨，图书馆今天也不开门。”“那就留在家里呗，今天只能这样了；明天不下雨再出去。”
meaning: marks resigned acceptance of the remaining option
grammar: 呗 accompanies acceptance of staying home after both proposed outings are blocked. 今天只能这样 explicitly establishes the resignation.

sentence: 弟弟正把桌布往自己这边拉，桌边的杯子已经开始晃，我马上说：“小安，别再拉啊！杯子快倒了。”
grammar: 啊 reinforces the warning addressed to 小安. The moving tablecloth and wobbling cup supply the immediate reason for stopping.

sentence: “我不想再等，准备回家了。”“再等我两分钟啊，这张图马上画完，我想请你帮我看看。”
meaning: adds a personal appeal to a request
grammar: 啊 gives the request a personal appealing tone after the listener expresses an intention to leave. The short wait serves the stated request for feedback on the drawing.

sentence: “你昨天想借的书，我今天带来了。”“谢谢你呀，我下午正好要用！”
grammar: 呀 adds warmth to the grateful response. After 你 nǐ, 啊 may be realized and written as 呀 ya.
note: This final particle is neutral-tone ya, distinct from the full-tone interjection yā.

sentence: “纸和彩笔都准备好了，下午一起画张图送给妈妈，好不好？”“好哇，我画花，你画树！”
grammar: 哇 expresses enthusiastic acceptance in 好哇. The w glide links the final sound of hǎo to the particle, a spoken variant of 啊.
note: The final particle is neutral wa here, distinct from standalone exclamatory wā.

sentence: “过了路口就到书店了？”“还远哪，过路口后还得走两公里；你累了就先坐下休息。”
grammar: After the n-ending syllable 远 yuǎn, 啊 may be realized and written as 哪 na. The reply emphasizes that substantial distance remains.
note: This neutral na is a final particle, distinct from interrogative 哪 nǎ meaning which.

sentence: 妈妈一直在门口等我，我推门进去，大声说：“妈，我回来啦！书也借到了，一共两本。”
grammar: 啦 combines change-of-state 了 with expressive 啊 in this announcement of arrival. It directs the update to the waiting mother.
note: The particle is neutral-tone la.

sentence: 大家都收好书包，已经站在门口等着；我拿起钥匙对大家说：“出发喽，去公园的路上再聊！”
meaning: calls attention to an imminent development
grammar: 喽 calls the waiting group's attention to the imminent departure with a lively announcing tone. It does not report a completed journey.
note: The departure-announcing particle is neutral-tone lou.

sentence: 弟弟正一遍遍敲桌子，我对他说：“别再敲了，我在听老师讲课，桌子一响就听不清。”
meaning: marks the requested cessation of an ongoing activity
grammar: Final 了 in 别再敲了 presents stopping as the requested change from the repeated knocking. It does not mark a completed knocking event.

sentence: “你答应周六帮大家搬书了？”“没有，我只说周六上午有空而已，还没答应搬书；下午我得上课。”
grammar: 而已 limits the claim to morning availability. It blocks the listener's stronger inference that the speaker has committed to moving books.

sentence: “你说他把椅子修好了？”“我只说他换了一个零件罢了，椅子现在还晃，不能说已经修好。”
grammar: 罢了 limits the report to replacing one component. The continued wobble shows that the chair has not been fully repaired.
note: The second syllable le is neutral in this restrictive expression.

sentence: “寄书时要不要再放一张写地址的纸？”“不用，收件人的地址已经写在信封上了，照着那个地址寄就是了，别另写一个。”
meaning: that is all you need to do
grammar: 就是了 follows the advised action and presents it as sufficient for the stated need. Final 了 is neutral-tone le.

sentence: “明天坐公交车还是地铁？”“公交车便宜，可要换两次；我们还带着行李，那就坐地铁好了，少走一点路。”
grammar: After the proposed action, 好了 settles the choice being discussed. It does not describe successful completion of the journey.

sentence: “我们今晚去看那场演出吧。”“刚问过，票已经卖完了。”“那算了，今晚不去了，留在家里听音乐吧。”
grammar: 算了 abandons the preceding proposal after its obstacle becomes known. 算 does not mean calculate here.
note: The second syllable is neutral-tone le in this expression.

sentence: 朋友已经替我洗了碗，又说要擦桌子、扫地，我说：“得了，你今天帮得够多了，剩下的我自己做，你坐下歇会儿。”
grammar: 得了 stops the friend's further offers. 得 is dé here, rather than obligation děi; 了 is neutral le.
register: A familiar, direct way to stop further insistence; it can sound abrupt.
note: 歇 xiē means rest.

sentence: “要买全新的书柜吗？”“不用，旧一点没关系，结实、能放下这些书就行，我不在意颜色。”
grammar: 就行 presents the preceding sturdiness and capacity criteria as sufficient. It leaves age and colour outside the required standard.
note: 在意 zàiyì means care about; 全新 quánxīn means brand-new.

sentence: 这把椅子坏得很厉害，我以为只能扔掉；爸爸竟然修好了，我坐上去试了试，一点也不晃。
grammar: 竟然 presents the successful repair as contradicting the speaker's explicit expectation that the chair could only be discarded.
note: 厉害 lìhai here means severe or extensive.

sentence: 我以为小安从没学过做饭，今天他居然独自做了一桌菜，还告诉我，他已经跟外婆学了半年。
grammar: 居然 marks the cooking as unexpected from the speaker's earlier belief. It does not inherently express criticism.
note: 独自 dúzì means alone, without another person doing the task alongside.

sentence: 早上妈妈看见乌云，说下午可能下雨，让我带伞；下午果然下了雨，我出门时用上了那把伞。
grammar: 果然 introduces an observed outcome matching the earlier prediction. It contrasts with 竟然, which marks an unexpected outcome.
note: 乌云 wūyún means dark cloud.

sentence: “你今天一直没精神，怎么了？”“昨晚楼上装修，我整夜没睡好。”“难怪你上课时总打哈欠，今晚早点休息吧。”
grammar: 难怪 presents the earlier observed yawning as understandable after the listener supplies the sleepless night as its explanation.
note: 没精神 méi jīngshen means lack energy; 装修 zhuāngxiū means renovate; 整夜 zhěng yè means the whole night.

sentence: 这台旧电脑播放视频有点慢，不过毕竟是借来的，能写完这次作业就够了；等还给姐姐以后，我再考虑买新的。
meaning: after all; taking this fact into account
grammar: 毕竟 invokes the acknowledged fact that the computer is borrowed to support a limited judgment of its adequacy despite its slow playback.
note: 视频 shìpín means video; 考虑 kǎolǜ means consider.

sentence: “午饭在学校吃，还是去你家吃？”“都可以，反正我们下午都要去图书馆，吃完一起走；在哪儿吃不影响这个安排。”
grammar: 反正 introduces the library plan that remains unchanged under either lunch arrangement.
note: 影响 yǐngxiǎng means affect.

sentence: 搬家前，客厅里堆了十几个大箱子，只留下一条窄路，简直像个小仓库，连坐的地方都没有。
grammar: 简直 strengthens the comparison with a small warehouse. The numerous boxes and lack of seating support the speaker's emphatic evaluation.
note: 客厅 kètīng means living room; 仓库 cāngkù means warehouse or storage room.

sentence: “你上午说三点来，刚才又说四点；到底几点到？我五点要出门，得先安排好晚饭。”
grammar: 到底 presses for a definite answer after two conflicting arrival times. It modifies the question rather than naming a physical endpoint.

sentence: 两张报名表上都写着“王林”，电话号码却不同；这究竟是同一个人填了两次，还是两个同名的人？我先按这两个号码打电话问问。
meaning: exactly; actually, in an unresolved question
grammar: 究竟 focuses inquiry on which of the two unresolved explanations is correct. It is a lexical alternative alongside 到底.
note: 同名 tóngmíng means have the same name.

sentence: “你只付了五十元。”“收据上明明写着一百元，日期和我的名字也都在这里；请你再核对一下。”
meaning: plainly; clearly, despite the contrary claim
grammar: 明明 presents the visible receipt as clear evidence contradicting the other speaker's claim about the payment.

sentence: 这周前六天都没下雨，我特意把野餐安排在周日，偏偏周日一早下起了大雨，只好取消。
meaning: as ill luck would have it; precisely contrary to one's wish
grammar: 偏偏 highlights the inconvenient coincidence between the planned picnic day and the rain. It does not imply that anyone deliberately caused it.
note: 特意 tèyì means deliberately for a particular purpose; 野餐 yěcān means picnic.

sentence: 妈妈说：“蛋糕等客人到了再切。”弟弟却说：“我偏要现在切，我不想等！”我把刀收起来，让他先去问妈妈。
grammar: 偏 before 要 emphasizes deliberate insistence on the action opposed by the mother's explicit request.
note: 刀 dāo means knife.

sentence: “这次活动很差，小安把开始时间说错了。”“你这评价太偏了，只说他的错误，却不提他后来接待了所有客人；两方面都该说。”
grammar: 偏 describes the evaluation as one-sided because it includes the mistake while excluding the explicitly identified contribution.
note: 评价 píngjià means evaluation or assessment.

sentence: “我们最早交了表，肯定能参加吧？”“未必，老师还要看每个人是否符合条件；早交只能说明交得早，先等答复。”
grammar: 未必 rejects certainty about participation without asserting that participation will be refused. The remaining eligibility check keeps both outcomes open.
note: 是否 shìfǒu means whether; 符合 fúhé means meet or conform to.

sentence: 上台前，我小声对姐姐说：“今天来了这么多人，我又是第一次主持，难免有点紧张；我先慢慢介绍，忘了顺序就看看本子。”
grammar: 难免 presents some nervousness as difficult to avoid under the speaker's particular first-time circumstances. It does not assert that everyone must react identically.
note: 上台 shàng tái means go onto the stage.

sentence: “明天六个人都能来吗？”“现在还难说，四个人答应了，另外两个人还没回消息；可能六个，也可能只有四个，今晚再确认。”
grammar: 难说 suspends judgment because two replies are missing. It concerns insufficient information, rather than difficulty pronouncing an expression.

sentence: 现在离开演还有十五分钟，公交车却堵在路上，司机说至少还要二十分钟才能到；我恐怕要迟到了，先发消息告诉朋友。
meaning: I'm afraid; probably, with an unwelcome expectation
grammar: 恐怕 introduces an unwelcome expectation based on the reported travel delay. It marks the speaker's prediction rather than describing fright.
note: 开演 kāiyǎn means begin a performance.

sentence: 办公室的灯还亮着，老师的外套也挂在门边；看来他还没走，我进去看看，问问明天的安排。
grammar: 看来 introduces an inference from the light and coat. The speaker then goes to check, so the inference is not presented as direct observation of the teacher.
note: This selected lexical reading retains full-tone lái.

sentence: 姐姐已经穿上外套，提着包往门口走；看样子是准备出门，我先问她要不要一起去买菜。
grammar: 看样子 introduces a conjecture based on the sister's visible preparations. The following question leaves her actual plan to be established.
note: 样子 yàngzi means appearance or outward state; zi is neutral-tone.

sentence: 远处那个戴红帽子的人好像是小安，可我看不清他的脸，也可能是别人；等他走近再打招呼。
meaning: seem to be; appear to be
grammar: 好像 presents the person's identity as an uncertain impression. The obscured face and explicit alternative prevent an assertion of established identity.
note: 打招呼 dǎ zhāohu means greet someone.

sentence: 我给姐姐留言：“这只钟原来每天慢五分钟；昨天换了电池，又照着手机把时间调好，今天核对时还跟手机上的时间一样，似乎走得准一些了。不过只看了一天，明天再核对。”
grammar: 似乎 hedges the impression of improved timekeeping. The one-day observation explicitly limits the available evidence.
note: 钟走得准 zhōng zǒu de zhǔn means a clock keeps accurate time. 似 is sì in 似乎.

sentence: 你说六点上车，坐两个小时就到家；现在九点了，想必已经到了吧？到了给我回个消息，我就放心了。
grammar: 想必 expresses a confident expectation from the stated departure and journey duration. The request for a reply shows that arrival has not been independently confirmed.

sentence: 姐姐早上说要先去还书，再来我家；现在十点半，图书馆十一点才开门，想来她还得过一会儿才能到，我先准备午饭。
grammar: 想来 draws an inference by considering the stated sequence and opening time. It does not express wanting to come.
register: A reflective expression that can sound more considered than conversational 看样子.
note: 来 retains full-tone lái in this inferential word.

sentence: 这批书有五箱，已经打开的两箱各有十本；我估计总共五十本，但剩下三箱还没数，登记时先别把五十当成确切总数。
grammar: 估计 introduces an estimated total inferred from a partial count. Because three boxes remain uncounted, fifty is not yet a verified total.
note: 确切 quèqiè means exact or definite.

sentence: 窗户开着，窗边的纸都落在地上；我推测是风吹落的，也可能是弟弟碰掉的，得先问问他，不能现在就确定原因。
grammar: 推测 introduces a possible causal explanation drawn from the open window and fallen papers. The alternative explanation remains explicit.
note: 吹落 chuīluò means blow down or blow off; 碰掉 pèngdiào means knock off by contact.

sentence: 姐姐把礼物装在盒子里，不让我打开；我只是猜测里面是杯子，其实还不知道，等生日那天打开才清楚。
grammar: 猜测 introduces a guess about the unopened box. 只是 and 还不知道 explicitly distinguish it from knowledge.

sentence: 我看到姐姐提着饭盒回来，以为她给我带了午饭；打开才发现里面是昨天借给同事的空碗，我还得自己做饭。
grammar: 以为 introduces the speaker's earlier assumption. Opening the container subsequently reveals that this particular assumption was mistaken.
note: 饭盒 fànhé means lunchbox or food container.

sentence: 姐姐认为把读书会改到上午更合适，因为下午教室外面有人排练；这是她的意见，我还想问问其他成员能不能早来。
grammar: 认为 attributes the following judgment to the sister. Her reason is stated, while the other members' availability remains unchecked.
note: 为 is wéi in 认为.

sentence: 门口那个包上写着姐姐的名字，还挂着她自己做的小布猫，我认定那是她的包，就打电话请她来取；她还没接电话。
grammar: 认定 presents the identification as the speaker's firm conclusion from the name and distinctive ornament. It does not itself report confirmation from the owner.
note: 布猫 bùmāo means a cloth cat ornament or toy here.

sentence: 小安说活动改到四点，是老师刚告诉他的；他以前转告时间从没出过错，我相信他的话，不过还是请他把老师的短信发来，方便通知大家。
grammar: 相信 takes 他的话 as the claim regarded as trustworthy. Past reliability grounds the trust; the original message is still being requested.

sentence: 卖家说这台电脑从没用过，可里面已经存着别人的照片；我怀疑它以前用过，准备先问清楚，还不能只凭照片就下结论。
grammar: 怀疑 introduces the suspected prior use prompted by a conflicting clue. The final qualification leaves that explanation unresolved.
note: 卖家 màijiā means seller; 凭 píng means on the basis of; 下结论 xià jiélùn means draw a conclusion.

sentence: “钥匙会不会落在教室里了？”“不会，我刚亲手把它放进这个包，又摸了一次，我确信就在里面；先别回学校找。”
grammar: 确信 introduces confidence in the key's present location. The speaker grounds that confidence in personally placing and checking it.
note: 落 là here means accidentally leave something behind. 亲手 qīnshǒu means with one's own hands.

sentence: 起初我不知道是哪只杯子漏水；把六只杯子分别装上水检查后，发现每只杯底都在滴水，我才断定不是只有一只漏水，而是六只都有问题。
grammar: 断定 marks reaching a definite conclusion after checking every cup. The conclusion is limited to the six inspected cups.
note: 起初 qǐchū means at first; 漏水 lòu shuǐ means leak water; 杯底 bēidǐ means the bottom of a cup.

sentence: 老师肯定了我这次主动帮助新同学的做法，也指出我讲得太快，让我下次先问对方听懂了没有；我把两点都记下了。
meaning: affirm the value of; acknowledge positively
grammar: 肯定 takes the helpful conduct as its object and positively acknowledges it. This transitive use differs from adverbial 肯定 meaning certainly.
note: 做法 zuòfǎ means way of doing something; 指出 zhǐchū means point out.

sentence: 我提议把读书会改到晚上，但六位成员中有四位晚上上课，大家就否定了这个提议；他们愿意改时间，只是晚上不合适。
grammar: 否定 takes the specific evening proposal as its object. The rejection concerns that arrangement rather than the proposer or every possible time change.
note: 提议 tíyì means proposal here.

sentence: “你刚买的这份包子有三个？”“我已经打开数过了，确实有三个，我们三个人一人一个正好。”
grammar: 确实 affirms the stated count on the basis of the speaker's own inspection.

sentence: “这条路近，走这条吧。”“的确近，比另一条少走一公里；不过路上没有灯，天已经黑了，我们还是走有灯的那条。”
grammar: 的确 acknowledges the shorter distance while the following qualification rejects choosing that route.
note: 的 is dí in 的确, rather than structural-particle de. 公里 gōnglǐ means kilometre.

sentence: “你再帮我搬一趟吧。”“我实在太累了，已经来回搬了十趟，现在连手都抬不起来；先让我歇十分钟。”
grammar: 实在 emphasizes the genuine extent of the speaker's fatigue and supports the request for a pause.
note: 抬不起来 tái bù qǐlai means cannot raise something here; 歇 xiē means rest.

sentence: “这把椅子是我自己做的，你坐着觉得怎么样？”“说实话，椅背有点硬，坐久了不太舒服；不过高度正好。”
grammar: 说实话 introduces a candid personal assessment in response to a request for feedback. The criticism is limited to comfort.
note: 高度 gāodù means height.

sentence: “这汤好喝吗？你别只夸我。”“老实说，味道不错，就是盐放多了，我想加一点水再喝。”
grammar: 老实说 introduces frank feedback after the cook explicitly requests more than praise.
note: 夸 kuā means praise. 老实 has neutral-tone shi in this selected reading.

sentence: “你真愿意周六帮我搬家，还是开玩笑？”“说真的，我已经请好假了，周六上午九点到；把新家的地址发给我吧。”
grammar: 说真的 asserts earnestness against the listener's explicit suggestion that the offer might be a joke.
note: 开玩笑 kāi wánxiào means joke; 请好假 qǐnghǎo jià means successfully arrange leave.

sentence: 我本来打算周六去买书，后来姐姐说那天要搬家，想请我帮忙；我就把买书改到周日，周六先去她家。
grammar: 本来 establishes the initial intention before a later request changes the arrangement.

sentence: 我试了几次都打不开门，以为锁坏了；姐姐把我手里的钥匙转了个方向，一下就打开了。我说：“原来是我把钥匙拿反了！”
meaning: so that is what happened; it turns out
grammar: 原来 introduces a newly discovered explanation that replaces the mistaken belief about the lock. It does not establish a former situation here.
note: 拿反 náfǎn means hold something the wrong way round.

sentence: 这张桌子倒是结实，我刚放了四箱书也没晃；可它太宽，搬不进我们那间教室，还是不能借。
grammar: 倒是 grants the favorable assessment of sturdiness while leaving the objection about width in force.
note: 搬不进 bān bù jìn means cannot move something inside.

sentence: “你只买了两本书？”“我可不是只买了两本，包里这六本都是今天刚买的，收据上也写着六本；你数一数。”
grammar: 可 strengthens the literal denial before 不是. The reply denies buying only two books; it does not express agreement through the fixed formula 可不是.

sentence: “你能看懂这本书，读起来一定很轻松。”“我并不觉得轻松，有些段落要读三遍才能懂；不过还是能读下去。”
grammar: 并不 explicitly contradicts the assumption of ease. Denying that reading is easy does not assert that understanding is impossible.
note: 段落 duànluò means paragraph.

sentence: 老师以为我不愿意帮忙，我在回复里写：“昨天没来并非不愿意，而是公交车半路出了故障；我已经出门，最后还是没赶到。”
meaning: is not; it is not the case that
grammar: 并非 denies unwillingness as the explanation. 而是 supplies the alternative explanation of a transport failure.
register: 并非 suits this written clarification; 并不是 is a common conversational alternative.

sentence: 上次我没问姐姐就把她的书借给同学，她第二天急着用，却找不到；我向她道歉，并保证：“以后没有你的同意，我绝不把你的书借给别人。”
grammar: 绝不 expresses a resolute commitment about the speaker's own future conduct. It does not describe a past habit or physical impossibility.
note: 保证 bǎozhèng means promise or give an assurance here.

sentence: “你确定最后一箱书里没有字典？”“绝对没有，我刚把里面的十本书一本一本拿出来看过，全是故事书；你再查查别的箱子。”
grammar: 绝对 strengthens the speaker's confidence in a bounded negative assertion, grounded in checking every book in that box.

sentence: “小安还没回短信，是不是不想来了？”“他早上说手机快没电了，说不定现在已经关机，也可能他还在上课；晚点再联系，先别认定他不来。”
grammar: 说不定 raises an unconfirmed explanation as a live possibility. The reply explicitly retains another possible explanation.
note: 关机 guānjī means switch off or be switched off, of a device. The middle bu is neutral in 说不定.

sentence: “书厚，内容肯定更详细。”“不见得，这本字很大，每页只有三行；那本薄的字小，每页有二十行，先看看内容再说。”
grammar: 不见得 rejects the inference from thickness to detail without asserting that the thicker book must contain less detail.
note: 行 háng counts lines of writing. Final de is neutral; lexical bù normally becomes bú before fourth-tone jiàn in connected speech.

sentence: 我出门后才发现钥匙没带，幸亏姐姐还在家，给我开了门，我才拿到钥匙；不然就得等她晚上回来。
grammar: 幸亏 credits the sister's actual presence with preventing a long wait outside. The final clause states the unwanted alternative.
note: 不然 bùrán means otherwise here.

sentence: 搬家时听见箱子里响了一下，我以为杯子碎了；打开一看，幸好六只杯子都完好，只是勺子掉到了箱底。
grammar: 幸好 expresses relief at the actual intact condition of the cups after an explicit fear of breakage.
note: 完好 wánhǎo means intact; 箱底 xiāngdǐ means the bottom of a box.

sentence: 我今天才看到通知，林老师昨天在图书馆介绍新书，可惜已经结束了，我没能去听；我本来很想当面问他一个问题。
grammar: 可惜 expresses regret about a missed opportunity. The late discovery and desired question explain why the missed event matters.
note: 当面 dāngmiàn means face to face.

sentence: 我约了四位老同学吃饭，最后来了三位，另一位临时加班，没能来；我有点遗憾，准备下周单独约他吃饭。
grammar: 遗憾 describes the speaker's feeling after 有点. The regret concerns one friend's absence rather than the whole gathering.
note: 单独 dāndú means separately or individually here.

sentence: 假如周六姐姐不加班，我们就一起给妈妈做晚饭；她现在还不知道那天要不要上班，今晚再确认。
grammar: 假如 introduces an unresolved future condition for the cooking plan. It does not assert that the sister is free.

sentence: 三箱书都没拆开，先假设每箱十本，三箱就是三十本；实际数量还没数，登记时不能把三十写成确认的总数。
grammar: 假设 explicitly stipulates ten books per box for a calculation. The resulting thirty is conditional on that assumption and remains unverified.
note: 实际 shíjì means actual.

sentence: 明天我们约好在公园门口见，万一下雨，就改在门口对面的书店等；现在还不知道明天的天气，先把备用地点也说好。
grammar: 万一 introduces a possible unwanted contingency for which the speakers establish a backup arrangement. It does not predict rain.
note: 备用 bèiyòng means kept available as a backup.

sentence: 借教室的申请还没答复；一旦老师同意，我就马上通知大家地点，现在先别发通知。
meaning: once; as soon as that condition is met
grammar: 一旦 presents approval as the future trigger for notifying everyone. The application remains unanswered now.
note: The reading retains lexical yī. Before fourth-tone dàn, 一 normally becomes yí in connected speech.

sentence: 老师说：“除非负责人同意，否则周六不能借这间教室；得到同意后，还要登记。”我还没去问负责人，先不通知大家。
grammar: 除非 introduces the necessary exception to the stated restriction. Agreement is required, but the separate registration requirement also remains.
note: 负责人 fùzérén means the person in charge.

sentence: 你来拿书前先给我打电话，不然我可能已经出门，你得白跑一趟；我接到电话就在家等你。
grammar: 不然 introduces the possible consequence of arriving without first calling. The final clause states what the call allows the speaker to arrange.
note: 白跑一趟 bái pǎo yī tàng means make a trip for nothing.

sentence: “我们想去的那家店今天关门，午饭怎么办？”“要不在家煮面？冰箱里还有鸡蛋。”“好，我去拿锅。”
grammar: 要不 introduces a proposed alternative after the restaurant plan becomes unavailable. The following reply accepts the suggestion.
note: 煮面 zhǔ miàn means cook noodles.

sentence: 读书组给成员的通知写着：“本次活动只需回复姓名，就能完成报名，不用填表。”我还没回复，打算今晚把名字发过去。
grammar: 只需 states the minimal action sufficient to complete registration under this group's stated arrangement.
register: Compact wording suited to this notice; 只需要 is also common.
note: 姓名 xìngmíng means full name.

sentence: 读书组给成员的通知写着：“若周六下雨，活动改在一楼教室，开始时间仍是三点；不下雨就在院子里。”
grammar: 若 introduces the rain condition governing the indoor arrangement. The notice also states the alternative for dry weather.
register: 若 is concise written wording here; 如果 and 要是 are common alternatives in conversation.

sentence: 我给新成员留言：“如有不清楚的地方，请今晚发消息问我；明天我们三点在图书馆门口集合。”
grammar: 如 introduces the condition 有不清楚的地方. In 如有, 如 retains its conditional role before the existential verb 有.
register: Compact wording in a written message; conversation often uses 如果有.
note: 集合 jíhé means assemble or meet as a group.

sentence: “周六我可以开车帮你搬家，前提是哥哥周五把车还给我；他还没确认时间，我先问清楚再答应。”
grammar: 前提是 names a requirement for the proposed help to be available. The speaker has not yet made an unconditional commitment.

sentence: “只要名单上写了名字，就算已经交钱。”这个说法不成立：姐姐的名字在名单上，可她今天还没付款；名单只记报名，不记付款。
grammar: 成立 evaluates whether the stated claim holds. The sister's listed name and unpaid status provide a counterexample.
note: 说法 shuōfǎ means a statement or way of putting something.

sentence: 明天能不能在院子里读书，取决于会不会下雨：不下雨就在院子里，下雨就进教室；现在还不知道明天的天气。
grammar: 取决于 links the location outcome to the unresolved weather factor. Both possible values and their corresponding arrangements are stated.

sentence: 办这次画画活动，需要一间空教室和每人一盒彩笔；教室已经借到，彩笔也按人数买齐，我们已经具备这些条件，活动下周才开始。
grammar: 具备 takes the required conditions as its object. Having the room and materials does not mean the activity has already taken place.
note: 买齐 mǎiqí means buy all the required items.

sentence: 我请老板找一把高度不到四十厘米的椅子；这把只有三十五厘米，符合我说的高度要求，不过我还要试试坐着稳不稳。
grammar: 符合 relates the chair's stated measurement to the explicit height criterion. It does not settle the separate question of stability.

sentence: 去公园读书的一共六个人，姐姐要求给每人准备一瓶水；我已经装好六瓶，满足了这个数量要求，不用再买。
grammar: 满足 takes 数量要求 as its object. The six available bottles meet the specified one-per-person requirement; the verb does not describe emotional contentment here.

sentence: 做这张剪纸，剪刀是必需的工具；纸和铅笔我都准备好了，就差剪刀，现在先去借一把。
grammar: 必需 modifies 工具 through 的. Unlike modal 必须 before an action, it characterizes an item as essential.
note: 剪纸 jiǎnzhǐ means a paper-cutting here; 铅笔 qiānbǐ means pencil; 工具 gōngjù means tool.

sentence: 门口的箱子把走廊挡住了，客人一会儿就到；为了让大家进屋，有必要先把箱子搬开，桌上的书可以晚点再收。
grammar: 有必要 followed by an action judges that action to be needed. Clearing access motivates moving the boxes before the optional tidying.
note: 为了 wèile introduces the intended purpose, here allowing everyone to enter.

sentence: 老师让我用十分钟介绍书名、内容和自己的看法；这三点都写好了，我又试着讲了两遍，每遍九分钟，准备得很充分，明天按这个顺序讲就行。
grammar: 充分 evaluates the preparation as adequate in extent. The completed content and timed practice support that assessment without guaranteeing tomorrow's performance.

sentence: 老师说：“周六有空教室就多练一次，没有就下周再练。”教室还没确认，我们这周还有练习的可能性，但也可能要等到下周；我先不改周六的安排。
grammar: 可能性 is a noun after 有, modified by 练习的. The unresolved room availability leaves both this week's practice and postponement possible.

sentence: 还不知道周六会不会下雨；即使下雨，我也去给外婆送饭，她已经说好在家等我。
grammar: 即使 introduces a hypothetical obstacle that does not change the decision. The sentence does not assert that rain will occur.

sentence: 那袋旧纸还没翻过，里面可能有外婆的信；哪怕只找到一封，我也觉得值得慢慢找，先别扔。
meaning: even if; even in the minimal case that
grammar: 哪怕 introduces a limiting hypothetical case. Finding just one letter would still make the search worthwhile.
note: 值得 zhíde means be worth doing.

sentence: “卖家说这台电脑从没用过，肯定是新的。”“这点还没核实；就算他说的是真的，我也不买，它卖三千元，我只准备了两千。”
grammar: 就算 provisionally grants the seller's unverified claim without accepting it as true. The price still rules out the purchase.
register: Conversational provisional concession.

sentence: 尽管这条路比大路多走一公里，我昨晚还是走了这条；这里有路灯，大路那段晚上没有灯。
grammar: 尽管 acknowledges the actual extra distance before reporting the contrary route choice. 尽 has third tone in this word.
note: 路灯 lùdēng means streetlight.

sentence: “这只包是新的，怎么还要换？”“虽说是刚买的，可拉链已经坏了，里面的东西容易掉出来；我想换只结实的。”
grammar: 虽说 acknowledges the recent purchase while rejecting its implication that the bag should be kept. 可 introduces the specific fault.
register: Natural in conversational acknowledgment followed by a qualification.

sentence: 我约了朋友周六去公园画画，还没收到回复；即使没人能来，我也按原计划出门，纸和彩笔已经准备好了。
grammar: 也 marks the decision as holding despite the hypothetical obstacle introduced by 即使. It does not add a second person performing the same action.

sentence: “这只包现在只卖二十元。”“再便宜我也不买，它没有拉链，我怕坐车时东西掉出来。”
meaning: however much more; even if more
grammar: 再 before 便宜 projects a further degree of cheapness. With 也不买, the purchase remains rejected even at that degree; 再 does not request repetition here.

sentence: 屏幕一直提示“密码错误”，我已经点了三次“登录”；输入的密码不改，再怎么点也进不去，先核对密码吧。
grammar: 再怎么 allows variation in the extent or manner of clicking, while the unchanged incorrect password entry prevents access. It is not a request for instructions.
note: 提示 tíshì means display a prompt here; 登录 dēnglù means log in.

sentence: 明天去学校，不管坐公交车还是骑车，我都八点出门；至于怎么去，今晚看天气再决定。
grammar: 不管 introduces the two transport alternatives, both of which leave the departure time unchanged. It does not mean refusing to manage something.

sentence: 我给姐姐留言：“无论坐六点到的车还是七点到的车，到站后都请给我打电话，我去接你；选好车再告诉我。”
grammar: 无论 presents two possible arrival services without selecting one. Calling after arrival applies to either choice.
register: 无论 fits this organized written message; 不管 is a common conversational counterpart.

sentence: 读书组的通知写着：“无论是否带书，都欢迎来参加，现场有书可以借。”我还没选好要带的书，先回复了姓名。
grammar: 是否 presents bringing a book and not bringing one as the two values of an embedded condition. The notice is not asking readers to answer a direct question.
register: 是否 is compact wording suited to this notice; conversation can use 带不带书.
note: 现场 xiànchǎng means at the event location here.

sentence: 老师说：“明天无论在院子里画画还是在教室里画画，都三点结束。”我把结束时间告诉家人，地点等明早看天气再定。
grammar: 都 applies the same ending time to each location alternative introduced by 无论. Its scope is the alternatives, rather than a set of people or objects.

sentence: 这块布太小，不管怎样铺，都盖不住整张桌子；换个方向铺也试过了，还是换块大的吧。
grammar: Under 不管, 怎样 ranges over possible ways of spreading the cloth rather than asking which method to use. The insufficient cloth size remains unchanged.
note: 盖 gài means cover.

sentence: 屋里开着暖气，我觉得不用穿外套；姐姐说：“不管屋里有多暖和，外面现在只有三度，出门得穿外套。”我就把外套拿上了。
grammar: 多 modifies 暖和 within 不管 and ranges over degrees of indoor warmth. It neither asserts a large quantity nor asks for a temperature answer.
note: 暖气 nuǎnqì means heating; 度 dù measures temperature degrees here.

sentence: 无论今晚在家吃还是去饭店吃，我都先给妈妈打电话，告诉她不用给我留饭；吃饭地点等下班再定。
grammar: 还是 joins the two alternatives governed by 无论. The sentence states what happens under either option rather than asking the listener to choose.
note: 留饭 liú fàn means save a meal for someone.

sentence: 公交车现在停在站里，司机说前面堵车，要等半个小时；与其坐着等，不如在这里下车走路，地图上显示十分钟就到。
grammar: 与其 introduces the less preferred action, waiting on the bus. 不如 introduces walking as the preferred alternative, supported by the stated travel times.
note: 显示 xiǎnshì means show or display.

sentence: 这只纸箱箱底已经破了，与其花时间用胶带补，不如换旁边那个完好的；大小一样，现在就能装书。
grammar: After 与其 presents a disfavored action, 不如 recommends the alternative action. This differs from directly comparing two options on an adjective such as 方便.
note: 胶带 jiāodài means adhesive tape.

sentence: 快车二十分钟能到，票价十元；慢车要四十分钟，只要两元。我宁可早起二十分钟坐慢车，也不想多花八元，明天还得留钱买本子。
grammar: 宁可 introduces an accepted cost, getting up earlier, preferred to the rejected extra expense. 宁 is nìng in this preference word.
note: 快车 kuàichē means express service; 慢车 mànchē means slower service.

sentence: 我明天要介绍一本书，宁可今晚少看半个小时电视，也不把准备留到明早；明早出门前只有十分钟，怕来不及。
grammar: 也不 introduces the rejected alternative after 宁可 states the accepted sacrifice. It rejects postponing preparation rather than adding an unrelated negative fact.
note: 看电视 kàn diànshì means watch television.

sentence: 周六我宁愿留在家里陪刚出差回来的姐姐，也不想去参加聚会；下次还有机会见朋友，姐姐周日就得走。
grammar: 宁愿 expresses the speaker's chosen preference between staying with the sister and attending the gathering. The sister's short visit supplies the reason.
note: 宁 has fourth tone in this preference word, as in 宁可.

sentence: 我在给读书组的活动记录里写：“由于老师临时生病，昨天的新书介绍取消了，已经报名的六个人都收到消息，没有白跑。”
grammar: 由于 introduces the actual cause of the cancellation. The report separately states that all six registered participants were informed.
register: 由于 suits this written activity record; 因为 is also common in conversation.

sentence: 我在给老师的记录里写：“投影仪突然坏了，大家看不到同一张照片，因而我们改为把纸质照片传给每个人看。”
grammar: 因而 introduces the practical consequence of losing shared projection. The change of method follows from that problem, rather than merely happening later.
register: 因而 suits this written explanation, alongside 因此.
note: 纸质 zhǐzhì means in paper form; 传 chuán here means pass from person to person.

sentence: 我在整理记录里写：“昨天把照片按月份分开，从而缩小了查找的范围；要找七月的照片，只翻七月那组就找到了。”
grammar: 从而 links sorting by month to the resulting narrower search range. The following July search illustrates how that change helped.
register: 从而 suits this written account of a method and its result.
note: 月份 yuèfèn means calendar month; 查找 cházhǎo means search for.

sentence: 活动室负责人给成员留言：“因门锁损坏，今天不能进屋，画画活动改在院子里；下午修好以后再通知大家。”
grammar: 因 introduces the reason phrase 门锁损坏. It functions independently here rather than as part of 因为.
register: 因 is compact written wording appropriate to this practical notice.

sentence: 我在给老师的说明里写：“昨天因记错集合地点而迟到了十分钟；通知写的是图书馆，我却先去了学校，后来才赶过去。”
grammar: In 因……而……, 而 links the stated cause to its result. The speaker's mistaken meeting place caused the late arrival; 而 does not introduce a contrast here.
register: 因……而…… suits this written explanation.

sentence: 我之所以没把这张合照发给大家，是因为右边那位同学闭着眼；他刚请我换一张，我正在重新挑。
grammar: 之所以 introduces the fact whose reason is explained by 是因为. The photograph has not been sent, and the closed eyes plus the classmate's request explain that choice.

sentence: “你不借这本书，是不喜欢故事吗？”“我之所以不借，是因为字太小，我看不清；故事我听你讲过，很喜欢。”
grammar: 是因为 identifies the actual reason after 之所以 introduces the decision. Small print is the reason, while the suggested explanation of disliking the story is rejected.

sentence: “老师已经把活动室借给我们，时间是明天下午三点到五点。”“既然如此，我现在就通知大家来排练，不再找别的教室了。”
grammar: 如此 resumes the stated room loan and time. In 既然如此, that established arrangement becomes the premise for notifying the group.

sentence: 昨天把字典和故事书混在一箱里，找字典时我翻了二十分钟；所以说，对我这次搬书来说，先把字典单独装一箱更省事，找的时候不用翻故事书。
meaning: so; that is why I say
grammar: 所以说 draws a practical conclusion from the preceding experience. The recommendation is explicitly limited to this speaker's current packing task.
note: 混 hùn means mix together; 省事 shěngshì means save trouble or effort.

sentence: 我的借书记录写着：“十本书约定周五前还，八本按时还了，两本周六才还。”可见这十本书没有全按时还；至于两本晚还的原因，记录里没写。
grammar: 可见 introduces a conclusion warranted by the stated count. The record establishes that not all ten returns were timely, but supplies no reason for the two late returns.

sentence: 报名表要求写姓名和电话号码，我刚看过的六份只有姓名；由此判断，这六份表还得补号码，其他表是否齐全还不知道。
grammar: 由此 points back to the stated requirement and the six inspected forms as the basis for judgment. The judgment does not extend to uninspected forms.
note: 齐全 qíquán means complete, with all required parts present.

sentence: 室友刚下夜班，我想让她多睡一会儿；出于对她的体谅，早上练习读课文时，我去了楼下的空教室。
grammar: 出于 introduces the speaker's stated motive for choosing another practice location. It explains the actor's choice rather than claiming to know someone else's thoughts.
note: 夜班 yèbān means night shift; 体谅 tǐliàng means consideration for another person's circumstances.

sentence: 我在说明里写：“昨天多出一条借书记录的问题源于我把同一本书登记了两次；今天核对书上的编号后删去重复的一条，表上十条，书也正好十本。”
grammar: 源于 identifies the concrete origin of the extra entry. Checking identification numbers and removing the duplicate restores agreement between the record and the books.
register: 源于 suits this written explanation of a problem's origin.
note: 编号 biānhào means identification number; 条 tiáo counts record entries here.

sentence: 昨天手机从三楼阳台的栏杆上往外滑落，姐姐伸手接住了；要不是她接得快，手机就会掉到楼下。
meaning: if it had not been for
grammar: 要不是 reverses the actual helpful event for consideration. The sister did catch the phone, and the fall to the ground below is the unrealized alternative.
note: 栏杆 lángān means railing; 滑落 huáluò means slide off and fall. The middle bu is neutral in this selected lexical reading.

sentence: 昨天店主本来五点关门，我五点半才能到；我提前打电话请他等我，他答应并把书交给了我，否则那天就取不到书了。
grammar: 否则 introduces what would have happened without the actual call and agreement to wait. The books were collected, so the negative outcome is counterfactual.

sentence: 这张纸明早还要用，你先收进抽屉，要不弟弟今晚收拾桌子时可能把它当废纸扔掉；他还不知道这张纸要留着。
grammar: 要不 introduces a possible consequence of not putting the paper away. It warns about that alternative rather than proposing a new activity for agreement.
note: 废纸 fèizhǐ means waste paper.

sentence: 我按下开关把灯打开，姐姐那时正好进门；灯亮和我按开关有因果关系，跟她进门只是时间碰巧相同，不能说是她让灯亮的。
grammar: 因果 modifies 关系 and names a cause-and-effect relation. The switch operates the light, while the sister's arrival merely shares the timing.
note: 碰巧 pèngqiǎo means by coincidence.

sentence: 这两张照片有联系：拍的都是同一座桥，一张是白天，一张是晚上；没有拍照日期，不能确定是不是同一天拍的。
grammar: 联系 is a noun after 有, naming the connection between the photographs. Their shared subject does not establish that they were taken on the same day.
note: 座 zuò is a classifier for structures such as bridges.

sentence: 借书表上只有“小安，周五借《种花》”，没有还书记录；这成了我向他核实的依据，还不能说明他没还，因为也可能是我漏记了。
grammar: 依据 is the noun naming grounds for checking with the borrower. Missing return documentation warrants checking but does not establish that the book was not returned.
note: 漏记 lòujì means omit from a record.

sentence: “大家都买这本字典，你为什么选另一本？”“我的理由是那本字大，我看着轻松；至于内容哪本更全，我还没比较，不能说字大就更全。”
grammar: 理由 names the speaker's stated justification for choosing a dictionary. Easier reading supports that preference without establishing more complete content.

sentence: 为了周六让妈妈休息，我打算和姐姐做晚饭；菜还没买，妈妈也还不知道我们的安排。
meaning: in order to; for the purpose of
grammar: 为了 introduces the intended purpose of the cooking plan. The meal and the mother's rest have not yet occurred; le is neutral within this word.

sentence: 姐姐留言：“请把你想借的三本书的书名今晚发给我，以便我明早先找出来，下午直接带给你。”
grammar: 以便 links sending the titles in advance to the intended later actions of finding and bringing the books. It does not report those actions as completed.
register: 以便 suits this organized written request; 好 can introduce a similar purpose conversationally.

sentence: 我在搬家的留言里写：“明天把每个箱子里的书列在纸上，贴在箱子外面，以免找一本字典时把所有箱子都拆开。”
grammar: 以免 introduces the unwanted later action that labeling the boxes is intended to avoid. It does not assert that every box will otherwise certainly be opened.
register: 以免 suits this written packing instruction; 免得 is a common conversational alternative.
note: 列 liè means list or set out in writing.

sentence: 这两只白杯子太像了，我们先各贴上名字，免得吃饭时拿错。
meaning: so that we do not; to avoid
grammar: 免得 introduces accidentally taking the wrong cup as the trouble the proposed labels are intended to prevent. The second syllable de is neutral.
register: 免得 is natural in this shared household proposal, alongside more written 以免.

sentence: 我今晚把明早要带的书装进包，省得明早着急找；明天七点就得出门。
meaning: to save the trouble of; so as not to have to
grammar: 省得 introduces later trouble or effort avoided by the planned preparation. 省 has third tone here, and de is neutral.
note: 着急 zháojí means feel anxious or rushed.

sentence: 我先把桌边的箱子搬开，好坐下来写字；作业还没开始写。
meaning: so as to; in order to
grammar: 好 connects clearing space to the same person's intended later action. It is a purpose connector here, rather than a quality adjective or an achieved result.

sentence: 我准备把书柜最下层空出来，好让弟弟自己拿到课本；现在他的书还放在最上层，每次都要我帮他拿。
meaning: so as to enable; so that someone can
grammar: 好让 introduces the intended enabling effect on another participant. The speaker will clear space, and the younger brother is to gain independent access to his books.

sentence: 我今天提前半小时到图书馆，为的是开会前读几页书；现在刚进门，还没坐下。
grammar: 为的是 focuses the intended purpose of an actual action. The early arrival has occurred, but the intended reading remains pending.

sentence: “这只包颜色很普通，你怎么选它？”“我就图个方便，三个口袋能把钥匙、手机和车票分开放，颜色我不在意。”
meaning: seek; be after a practical advantage
grammar: 图 takes the advantage sought, here 方便. 图个方便 means choose something for convenience, without implying that convenience is the only possible motive.
note: 普通 pǔtōng means ordinary. 个 retains lexical gè; it can weaken to ge in unstressed speech.

sentence: 明天读书会在院子里，我打算把空教室的钥匙也带上，以防突然下雨，大家可以进去接着读。
grammar: 以防 introduces a possible contingency motivating the backup preparation. Carrying the key provides an indoor option rather than preventing rain itself.

sentence: 我在日记里写：“今天为明天的家庭聚会而提前买菜，想让妈妈明晚不用做饭；菜已经买回来了，饭明天再做。”
grammar: 为 introduces the event motivating the advance purchase in 为……而……. Its complement is the planned gathering, rather than a person receiving a benefit.
register: The complete 为……而…… frame gives this diary explanation a more deliberate written style than everyday 为了.
note: 日记 rìjì means diary.

sentence: 我在给老师的留言里写：“我为明天能参加排练而提前请了假，明天下午会准时到教室。”
meaning: links a purpose to the action taken for it
grammar: In 为……而……, 而 connects the intended participation to obtaining leave in advance. Unlike 因……而……, the first part states a future purpose rather than an actual cause.
register: This explicit correlative frame suits the written explanation to a teacher.

sentence: 我们六个人每人交了十元，这六十元全部用于买周六读书会要喝的饮料；钱还在我这里，明天才去买。
meaning: be used for; be allocated to
grammar: 用于 links the identified funds to their designated use. The final clause makes clear that allocation does not mean the money has already been spent.

sentence: 读书会桌上的纸条写着：“这两本字典供成员查词，用完请放回桌上，不要带走。”
grammar: 供 introduces the intended users and their use of the dictionaries: 成员查词. It is gōng in this supply-for-use sense.
register: 供 is compact wording for this written resource label; 给成员用 is a conversational alternative.
note: 查词 chá cí means look up a word.

sentence: 我把借书人的姓名和电话号码写在同一行，便于你明天按姓名查电话；名单还没发，我核对完就给你。
grammar: 便于 takes the task made easier by the arrangement. Keeping each name beside its number facilitates looking up that person's telephone number.
note: 行 háng means a line of writing here.

sentence: 我介绍书时第一遍漏了两点，把三点写在纸上再讲，只漏了一点；这张提纲有助于我记住内容，但还得再练。
grammar: 有助于 states a helpful contribution to remembering the content. The two local attempts support a limited assessment, while the remaining omission rules out a guarantee.
note: 提纲 tígāng means outline.

sentence: 这周我的目标是把借来的三本故事书都读完；现在只读完一本，还有两本，周五晚上还要还书。
grammar: 目标 names the intended outcome. Reading all three books defines success, while the current one-book total shows that the goal remains unmet.

sentence: 我只对姐姐说了“再试一次”，她以为我不相信她；我解释：“我的意图是请你检查刚换的零件，不是说你不会修。”
grammar: 意图 names the speaker's stated intention behind the request. The explanation distinguishes that intention from the sister's interpretation.

sentence: 我报名帮读书组整理旧书，朋友问我是不是想得到奖励。我说：“我的动机是认识更多喜欢读书的人；没人答应给我奖励，我也没打算要。”
grammar: 动机 names the actor's explicitly stated reason for volunteering. It does not establish whether the hoped-for social result will occur.

sentence: 我给新成员发了“早点来，可以先聊聊”这条消息。他问是不是必须提前到，我解释：“我的用意是邀请你先认识大家，不是要求你提前到。”
grammar: 用意 names the intended point behind the quoted message. Its author explains the invitation and rejects the interpretation of an arrival requirement.

sentence: 这次吵架的起因是弟弟在姐姐看书时大声放音乐；姐姐请他调小，他不肯，两人才吵起来。
meaning: initiating cause; origin of an incident
grammar: 起因 names what initiated this particular quarrel. The following request, refusal and argument spell out the development from that starting cause.
note: 调小 tiáoxiǎo means turn down a setting; 不肯 bù kěn means be unwilling.

sentence: 我留下这把旧椅子，是因为它是外婆亲手做的；姐姐知道这个缘故以后，答应周末陪我一起修。
grammar: 这个缘故 refers back to the stated reason for keeping the chair. 缘故 supplies another noun for a concrete reason.

sentence: 我昨晚忘了给手机充电，后果是今天到车站时手机没电了，存在里面的车票一时打不开；我只好找工作人员帮忙。
grammar: 后果 names the consequence of the stated omission. Here it is an unwelcome practical result, rather than something the speaker intended.

sentence: 我本来想早点到公园，避开人多的时候，结果坐错了公交车，绕了一大圈，中午才到，比平时还晚。
grammar: 结果 links the earlier intention to what actually happened next. Here it introduces an outcome contrary to the intended early arrival, rather than functioning as an outcome noun.
note: 避开 bìkāi means avoid or keep clear of.

sentence: 我写的短故事里，孩子出门踢球前发现小猫不见了，后来在纸箱里找到了它；结局是孩子抱着小猫留在家里，没有按原计划去踢球。
grammar: 结局 names how the supplied story ends. The final stay at home contrasts with the child's original plan to go out.

sentence: 我给组员留言：“昨天的读书会已经结束，后续安排是周五归还借来的书，周六核对记录；我负责登记，姐姐负责联系没还书的人。”
grammar: 后续 modifies 安排 and identifies actions following the completed reading meeting. The message states the actual follow-up tasks, dates and responsible people.
note: 组员 zǔyuán means group member.

sentence: 弟弟把锅盖当帽子戴，立刻引起大家的笑声；外婆也笑着说：“这帽子可太大了！”
grammar: 引起 takes the resulting reaction, 大家的笑声, as its object. The grandmother's response makes the actual laughter explicit.
note: 锅盖 guōgài means pot lid; 立刻 lìkè means immediately.

sentence: 我在群里写了“周六早点来”，没写几点，引发了一场关于时间的讨论：有人以为两点，有人以为三点；我补上“两点半集合”后，大家才不再猜。
grammar: 引发 takes the resulting discussion as its object. The quoted vague message, differing interpretations and later clarification establish the local causal sequence.
note: 群 qún here means a group chat; 猜 cāi means guess.

sentence: 上周我把同一本书登记了两次，核对时才发现；这次错误促使我改了办法，现在每登记一本，都先核对书上的编号。
meaning: prompt someone to; lead someone to act
grammar: 促使 takes the person prompted, 我, followed by the action taken. The duplicate entry motivates an actual change of method without expressing permission or coercion.

sentence: 我们原来在院子里排练，突然下起大雨，院里又没有能挡雨的地方；大雨迫使我们把排练改到空教室里。
grammar: 迫使 links an actual constraint to the people compelled to change their arrangement. The rain and absence of shelter rule out continuing the outdoor rehearsal.
note: 挡雨 dǎng yǔ means provide shelter from rain.

sentence: 今天要把四张桌子搬进活动室，走廊里却堆满纸箱，阻碍了我们的搬运工作；半小时只搬进一张，其他三张还在门外。
grammar: 阻碍 describes an obstacle hindering the moving task. One table has been moved, so the obstruction slows progress without completely preventing the work.
note: 搬运 bānyùn means carry or transport. The apostrophe in zǔ'ài separates the vowel-initial syllable ài.

sentence: 读书会六个人分成两组，每组的三个人轮流发言；每人只等同组另外两个人讲完，就又轮到自己。这样的安排有利于增加每个人的发言机会，但不要求不想说的人一定开口。
grammar: 有利于 relates the smaller-group arrangement to increased speaking opportunities. Favorable conditions do not mean every member must or will speak.
note: 增加 zēngjiā means increase; 发言 fāyán means speak in a group discussion.

sentence: 刚才姐姐报名字，我一遍就听清了；现在旁边大声放音乐，我已经听错两次，这种环境不利于核对名单，我们换间教室吧。
grammar: 不利于 identifies a condition that works against checking the names accurately. The contrast between clear hearing and two errors supplies an actual adverse mechanism.
note: 报名字 bào míngzi means read out names. In connected speech, 不 normally becomes bú before fourth-tone lì; the reading retains lexical bù.

sentence: 我想确认明天几点开门，可手里只有一张没写时间的门口照片；反复看这张照片无助于确认开门时间，还是直接问负责人吧。
meaning: not help with; contribute nothing to
grammar: 无助于 denies a helpful contribution to the stated goal. A photograph without timing information does not establish opening hours; the expression does not itself assert harmful effects.

sentence: 我以为桌腿下多垫一块木片会更稳，试过后桌子反而晃得更厉害，杯里的水都洒了；我马上拿掉木片。
meaning: instead; contrary to the expected effect
grammar: 反而 marks an effect opposite to the explicit expectation: the added support was expected to improve stability but increased wobbling.
note: 垫 diàn means put underneath as padding or support; 木片 mùpiàn means a thin piece of wood.

sentence: 我想让新同学不那么紧张，就请大家一起鼓掌欢迎；他小声说：“这样反倒更紧张，我想先和你一个人聊聊。”
meaning: instead; contrary to what was expected
grammar: 反倒 introduces the new classmate's reported reaction opposite to the host's intended reassurance. 倒 has fourth tone in this word.
register: 反倒 is natural in the classmate's conversational explanation, alongside 反而.

sentence: 我想周六做外婆爱吃的菜；为此，今天先给妈妈打了电话，问清外婆最近想吃什么，明天再去买菜。
meaning: for this purpose; to that end
grammar: 为此 refers back to the stated cooking goal and presents the telephone call as preparation toward it. 为 is wèi in this purpose relation.

sentence: 我和姐姐已经说好，周六我买菜，她先在家煮饭；这样一来，两边可以同时做，不用等我买完菜她才开始，晚饭就能早一点做好。
meaning: with this arrangement; as a result
grammar: 这样一来 resumes the agreed division of work and introduces its expected consequence. The agreement is established, while Saturday's cooking remains future.
note: 来 retains full-tone lái in this expression. In connected speech, 一 normally becomes yì before second-tone lái; the reading retains lexical yī.

sentence: 去年我第一次去读书组，大家帮我找到一本找了很久的旧书；从此，我每周六都去，已经坚持一年了，今天还准备带姐姐一起去。
grammar: 从此 makes the first visit the starting point of a continuing weekly practice. It does more than introduce a single later event.

sentence: 这次我只听同学转告，没核实集合地点，白跑了一趟；我现在决定，今后收到活动通知，都先向负责人确认地点再出门。
meaning: from now on; in the future
grammar: 今后 identifies the future period beginning at the speaker's present decision. It does not report an already established practice continuing from a past event.

sentence: 我第一次给林老师写信，开头写道：“林老师，您好！我是新来的学生小安，想请教您一个关于课程的问题。”
grammar: 您好 combines respectful 您 with 好 as a greeting addressed to the teacher.
register: A respectful greeting suitable for this first letter to a teacher.
note: 请教 qǐngjiào means ask someone for guidance or advice.

sentence: 老师请我们写一段家庭介绍，我写道：“我的母亲在小学教中文，晚上常陪我读书。”
register: 母亲 is a more formal alternative to 妈妈, natural in this written family introduction.
note: 小学 xiǎoxué means primary school.

sentence: 我在发给课程小组的家庭介绍里写：“我的父亲是一名工人，周末喜欢修理家里的旧东西。”
register: 父亲 is a more formal alternative to 爸爸, suitable for this written introduction.

sentence: 读书组给成员的通知写着：“上次活动在院子里，本次活动改在一楼教室，请周六下午三点直接到教室集合。”
grammar: 本次 identifies the particular activity addressed by the notice, contrasting it with 上次.
register: Common in event notices; 这次 is a conversational counterpart.

sentence: 我在给新成员的说明里写：“周六下午有一次旧书交换活动，该活动只交换书，不出售书，请带自己愿意换出的书来。”
grammar: 该活动 refers back to the book exchange just introduced. 该 modifies a noun here; it does not express obligation.
register: Written reference wording; conversation commonly repeats the name or uses 这个活动.
note: 交换 jiāohuàn means exchange; 出售 chūshòu means sell.

sentence: 读书组发给成员的通知写着：“新书介绍会于周六下午三点开始，地点是一楼教室，请提前五分钟到。”
grammar: 于 introduces the time before 开始. The time phrase specifies Saturday at three in the afternoon.
register: 于 suits this written announcement; 在 is a common conversational alternative in this temporal frame.
note: 新书介绍会 xīnshū jièshàohuì means a presentation of a new book.

sentence: 老师给全班的通知写着：“明天请带课本及字典，练习用的纸和笔由学校提供。”
grammar: 及 coordinates the two noun expressions 课本 and 字典.
register: Concise written coordination in a materials notice; 和 is natural in conversation.

sentence: 画画小组给成员留言：“请带纸和彩笔，以及两张愿意给大家看的旧照片；照片只用来介绍自己，不用交给老师。”
grammar: 以及 adds the photograph noun group to the preceding group of drawing materials.
register: 以及 helps organize the grouped list in this written message.

sentence: 读书组的报名通知写着：“请用短信或电子邮件回复姓名，两种方式选一种就行，不必都发。”
grammar: 或 joins two acceptable methods in a statement. The notice explicitly says that either one is sufficient.
register: 或 is a concise written counterpart to 或者 here.
note: 电子邮件 diànzǐ yóujiàn means email.

sentence: 我在发给成员的活动记录里写：“昨天每个人都介绍了自己带来的书，并且回答了其他成员的问题；六个人都轮到了。”
grammar: 并且 adds answering questions to introducing books. Both actions are reported as having occurred.

sentence: 我给活动负责人写信：“请告知明天集合的具体地点，通知里只写了下午三点。”他回复：“在图书馆正门，不是在学校门口。”
grammar: 告知 takes the requested information as its object. The letter's writer is the understood recipient of that information.
register: A more formal informing verb than 告诉, suitable for this request to an organizer.
note: 正门 zhèngmén means main entrance.

sentence: 读书会给成员的通知写着：“周六下午，活动室免费供应热水，茶叶请自带；用完杯子请自己洗干净。”
grammar: 供应 takes 热水 as the item made available through the event's service arrangement.
note: 茶叶 cháyè means tea leaves; 自带 zìdài means bring one's own.

sentence: 课程结束后，我给林老师写信：“我第一次主持讨论时，您给予了我很大帮助，提醒我看提纲，还帮我安排发言顺序。谢谢您！”
grammar: 给予 takes recipient 我 and the abstract object 很大帮助. 给 is read jǐ within this word.
register: 给予 suits the formal expression of gratitude in this letter; 给 is more conversational.
note: 提纲 tígāng means outline.

sentence: 参加学校的读书会，让我获得了向作者提问的机会；我当场问了他为什么给书起这个名字。
grammar: 获得 takes 机会 as the thing gained. The subsequent question shows that the opportunity was actually available and used.
note: 提问 tíwèn means ask a question; 起名字 qǐ míngzi means give something a name.

sentence: 我在给课程小组的活动记录里写：“本周的旧书整理已完成，所有书都按书名放好，向帮忙的六位同学致谢。”
grammar: 向帮忙的六位同学 identifies the recipients of the thanks; the completed organizing work supplies its reason.
register: 致谢 suits a written acknowledgment such as this activity record.

sentence: 邻居帮我把重桌子搬上楼，我收拾好以后去他家，向他道谢：“谢谢你，今天真麻烦你了。”
grammar: 道谢 names the act of thanking. 向他 identifies the helper being thanked, and the quotation gives the actual thanks.

sentence: 我给老师的邮件里写：“昨天我把见面地点写错了，让您白跑了一趟，向您致歉；应该在图书馆门口，不是在学校门口。”
grammar: 向您 identifies the apology's recipient. The incorrect location and its consequence state the wrong being acknowledged.
register: 致歉 is a formal apology verb suited to this email; 道歉 is also natural for the action.
note: 邮件 yóujiàn here means an email; 白跑一趟 bái pǎo yī tàng means make a trip for nothing.

sentence: 我在给同学的留言里写：“昨天我没按约定还书，让你上课时没有课本，我向你表示歉意；书今天中午送到你手里。”
grammar: 歉意 is the noun object of 表示. 向你 identifies the person to whom the regret is expressed.
register: 表示歉意 is a more formal apology expression suitable for this written message.

sentence: 我在给课程小组的记录里写：“昨天六位成员出席了读书会，轮流介绍了自己带来的书；另外两位请了假，没有参加。”
grammar: 出席 takes 读书会 as the organized event attended. Six attendees are distinguished from two absent members.
register: 出席 is more formal reporting wording than 参加 here; it is not restricted to officials.

sentence: 今天读书会的地点是二楼教室；姐姐用电话参加讨论，我则已经到场，正给大家摆椅子。
meaning: arrive at the event site; be present on site
grammar: 到场 specifies physical presence at the established event site, contrasting with the sister's participation by telephone.

sentence: 读书会才进行到一半，姐姐就接到家里的电话，需要回去照顾孩子；她向主持人说明以后提前离场，我们留下继续讨论。
grammar: 离场 describes the sister's departure from the meeting site. The other participants continue, so her departure does not end the event.

sentence: 我给来接我的姐姐发消息：“我已经到达你家附近的车站，刚下车，正往出口走，你在哪里？”
grammar: 到达 takes the station as its destination. 已经 and 刚下车 establish that arrival has occurred.
register: 到达 is a fuller arrival word suitable for this written travel update and also usable in speech.

sentence: 我给组员发了用钱的说明：“大家交的六十元已经用来购买明天的六瓶果汁，收据放在桌上，大家可以核对。”
grammar: 购买 takes 六瓶果汁 as the purchased goods. The message identifies the funds and the receipt for checking.
register: 购买 is a fuller alternative to 买, natural in this written explanation of group spending.

sentence: 读书组以前总要借学校的投影仪；今年我们购置了一台，现在每周看短片都用自己的，不用再借。
grammar: 购置 describes buying equipment for the group's continuing use. 一台 refers to the previously named projector.
register: 购置 commonly accompanies equipment and durable items, rather than every ordinary purchase.
note: 投影仪 tóuyǐngyí means projector.

sentence: 老师给我留言：“请使用门边的卷尺量一下桌子的长度，把结果写在这张纸上，量完再把卷尺放回盒子里。”
grammar: 使用 directly takes the tool 卷尺 as its object. This is a lexical use verb, unlike instrumental 用 before another action.
register: 使用 is a fuller alternative to the verb 用, suitable for this practical instruction.
note: 卷尺 juǎnchǐ means tape measure.

sentence: 老师上次教我先列提纲再介绍书；这次介绍新借的故事书，我运用了这个方法，先写下三点，再按顺序讲。
meaning: apply; put a method into practice
grammar: 运用 takes the previously learned method as its object. The following actions show how the speaker applies it to another book.
note: 列提纲 liè tígāng means draw up an outline.

sentence: 整理这二十张照片，可以按日期分，也可以按照片里的人分；我们采用了按日期分的办法，同一天拍的放在一起。
meaning: adopt; choose and use a method
grammar: 采用 identifies the method selected from two stated alternatives. The final clause describes the chosen grouping procedure.

sentence: 做装笔的纸盒时，我试过薄纸，放两支笔就变形；后来选用了厚纸，折好的盒子放四支笔也没变形。
grammar: 选用 takes the material chosen for a practical use. The earlier deformation explains why thicker paper was selected.
note: 变形 biànxíng means change shape or become deformed.

sentence: 弟弟一遍遍敲桌子，我请他停止敲打；他就把手放在腿上，不再敲了，我终于能听清录音。
grammar: 停止 takes 敲打 as the action to cease. The subsequent still hands and absence of knocking establish that it stopped.
note: 敲打 qiāodǎ means knock or tap repeatedly.

sentence: 讨论进行到一半，主持人说：“现在三点二十，先暂停十分钟，三点半接着讨论刚才的问题，大家可以去喝点水。”
grammar: 暂停 marks a temporary interruption. The ten-minute interval and explicit restart time establish planned resumption.

sentence: 读书组给成员的通知写着：“周五晚上的活动连续三次只有一人参加，我们决定终止这项活动，不再安排下一次；周六下午的读书会照旧。”
grammar: 终止 ends the named Friday activity series. 不再安排下一次 distinguishes this decision from a break with planned resumption.
register: 终止 suits this formal announcement of an arrangement ending.
note: 连续 liánxù means consecutive or in succession.

sentence: 读书组通知成员：“这周六下午三点的读书会延期到下周六下午三点，地点仍是原来的教室，这周六教室要修窗户。”
grammar: 延期到 introduces the replacement date. The meeting remains planned, with its room and clock time unchanged.

sentence: 我们原定六点开饭，但姐姐六点半才下班；妈妈把晚饭时间延后到七点，菜先留在锅里，等她回来一起吃。
grammar: 把晚饭时间延后到七点 moves the meal's scheduled time from six to seven. The meal is delayed rather than abandoned.
note: 开饭 kāi fàn means start a meal.

sentence: 我给第一次来的同学发邀请：“我们周六下午三点在图书馆门口见，届时我会带你去二楼教室，介绍大家认识，请别直接上楼。”
grammar: 届时 points to the specified future meeting time, Saturday at three, when the planned guidance will occur.
register: 届时 is common in written invitations and arrangements; 到时候 is conversational.

sentence: 我给组员发消息：“目前只有一楼教室可以借，二楼的申请还没答复；等有了答复，我再通知大家，先别改地点。”
grammar: 目前 limits the availability statement to the present status. The pending application leaves a possible later change unresolved.
register: 目前 is natural in status updates; 现在 is a common conversational counterpart.

sentence: 明天朋友第一次来我家，我已经事先把地址和从车站走来的路线发给他，免得他找不到门。
grammar: 事先 places sending the directions before the friend's specified visit. The preparation has already happened; the visit is tomorrow.
note: 路线 lùxiàn means route.

sentence: 画画活动明天下午三点开始，我今天已经预先把纸裁成了每人要用的大小，明天大家到了就能直接画，不用再等。
grammar: 预先 places preparing the paper before tomorrow's drawing activity. The completed preparation enables a later prompt start.
note: 裁 cái means cut material such as paper or cloth to the required size.

sentence: 昨天到姐姐家，我先把借来的字典还给她，随后一起去厨房做饭，饭后才看搬家时拍的照片。
grammar: 随后 places cooking after returning the dictionary. It orders the events without itself stating a causal relation.

sentence: 弟弟把水洒在地上，妈妈正要走过来；我立即提醒她地上很滑，她停在门口，等我擦干再走。
grammar: 立即 marks the warning as promptly following the spill and the mother's approach. It does not specify an exact number of seconds.

sentence: 姐姐说：“下周六要一起做饭，你想吃什么，尽早告诉我，我周五下班后就去买菜，别等到周六才说。”
grammar: 尽早 requests an early reply so the choice can inform Friday's shopping before Saturday's cooking. 尽 is jǐn here, rather than exhaustion-result jìn.

sentence: 我给姐姐解释为什么想上这门课：“首先，上课时间在周末，不影响工作；其次，教室离家近，走路十分钟就到。”
grammar: 其次 introduces the second reason in the ordered explanation. It does not describe a later event.

sentence: 这次去姐姐家，公交车晚到了十分钟，车上却一直有座位；总的来说，路上还算舒服，我下次不赶时间时还会坐。
grammar: 总的来说 introduces an overall assessment that takes both the delay and the available seating into account.
note: 还算舒服 hái suàn shūfu means fairly comfortable.

sentence: 这间房一方面离公司近，能让我少坐半小时车；同时房租也在我的预算内，所以我想再去看看。
meaning: on one hand; for one aspect
grammar: 一方面 introduces one relevant aspect of the assessment. 同时 adds the other aspect, affordability; the two are not successive events.
note: In connected speech, 一 normally becomes yì before first-tone fāng; the reading retains lexical yī.

sentence: 我还没决定要不要和朋友合租：一方面每月能少付一千元房租，另一方面两个人作息不同，得先商量睡觉时能不能放音乐。
grammar: 另一方面 introduces the second consideration after 一方面. The saving favors sharing, while differing routines require further discussion.
note: 作息 zuòxī means daily work-and-rest routine. 一 normally becomes yì before fāng in connected speech.

sentence: 我给新成员的留言写着：“周六三点在一楼教室集合；此外，请每人带一本愿意借给大家的书，我会把书名写在借书表上。”
grammar: 此外 adds the book request to the already stated meeting arrangement.
register: 此外 is common in organized written messages; 另外 is also natural for adding a point.

sentence: 照片已经按月份分好了，接下来我要把每组放进一个信封，再在外面写上月份。
grammar: 接下来 introduces the planned packing phase after the sorting has been completed. Its final syllable lai is neutral.

sentence: 最初这次聚会只有四个人报名，后来又有两个人能来，我就按六个人准备了饭菜。
grammar: 最初 establishes the initial four-person registration count before the later addition of two people.

sentence: 我种的豆子第一周只长出小芽，第二周有两片叶子，一个月后长到二十厘米；它在这段时间里逐渐长高了。
grammar: 逐渐 presents growth as developing over the stated period. The sprout, leaves and later height give intermediate observations.
note: 叶子 yèzi means leaf; 长高 zhǎnggāo means grow taller.

sentence: 晚饭后，客人先走了两位，又走了三位，最后只剩我和姐姐；屋里渐渐安静下来，我们才开始收拾桌子。
grammar: 渐渐 describes the room becoming quieter as guests leave in successive groups. It supplies another word for gradual change.

sentence: 自从三个月前搬到学校旁边，我有课时都走路去；这三个月从没再坐公交车上学。
grammar: 自从 introduces the move as the starting event for the subsequent walking routine, which continues through the stated three months.

sentence: 姐姐周一到周三出差，我在她出差期间每天去她家浇花；周四她回来以后，我把钥匙还给了她。
grammar: 期间 follows 出差 to name the interval during which the daily visits occur. The trip is explicitly bounded from Monday to Wednesday.

sentence: 我在整理照片的过程中，先按月份分开，再把同月的装进一个信封；现在找七月的照片，只用打开七月的信封。
grammar: 过程 names the sequence of sorting and packing activities. In 在……过程中, 中 locates something within that process.

sentence: 老师问哪些办法能提醒自己带书，我举例说：“我睡前把明天的课本放进书包，早上就不用临时找了。”这只是我用的一个办法。
grammar: 举例 names the action of giving an instance. Packing the textbook before bed exemplifies a method for remembering to bring it.
note: 睡前 shuì qián means before going to sleep.

sentence: 周六聚会已经分好了工；具体来说，姐姐负责买菜做饭，我买饮料、摆桌子，弟弟饭后洗碗。
grammar: 具体来说 introduces the actual assignments that make the general statement about divided work precise.

sentence: 学做饭时，姐姐教我切菜；学用电脑时，反过来是我教她在表格里输入姓名，我们各教自己熟悉的事。
meaning: the other way around; with the roles reversed
grammar: 反过来 reverses the stated teacher–learner relation: the sister first teaches the speaker, and the speaker teaches her in the other activity.
note: The final syllable lai is neutral in this expression.

sentence: 从家到学校，公交车要三十分钟，地铁只要十五分钟；相比之下，地铁更省时间，不过要多花两元。
grammar: 相比之下 introduces a comparison of the two stated travel times for the same journey. The extra fare remains a separate consideration.

sentence: 我去年每月房租三千元，今年搬家后每月两千五百元；与去年相比，今年每月少付五百元，水电费另外算。
grammar: 与去年相比 establishes last year's monthly rent as the comparison standard. Both amounts exclude the separately calculated utility charges.

sentence: 从总体看，今天的读书会进行得很顺利：六个人都介绍了书，也都回答了问题；只是开门晚了五分钟，没有耽误后面的安排。
grammar: 从总体看 considers the identified meeting as a whole. The delayed opening remains a limited exception to the favorable assessment.
note: 顺利 shùnlì means smoothly or without significant difficulty.

sentence: 老师的留言写着：“三点开始介绍书，四点登记借书，五点结束。”我向姐姐概括了活动安排：“三点到五点，先介绍书，再登记借书。”留言没有说在哪间教室。
grammar: 概括 describes giving the main outline of the supplied message. The summary preserves the activity order and overall interval without supplying a missing room.

sentence: 搬书时，有一箱没贴书名，找字典多花了二十分钟；其他三箱贴好了，直接找到了要用的书。收拾完，我和姐姐总结这次搬书的经验：“下次每箱都贴书名，找起来方便些。”
grammar: 总结 takes 这次搬书的经验 as its object. The speakers draw a practical lesson from the explicitly described packing experience.
note: 经验 jīngyàn means practical experience or lessons gained from it.

sentence: 课堂上，老师请我按时间顺序叙述今天找钥匙的经过，我说：“先在车站发现钥匙不见了，再回家找，最后在外套口袋里找到。”
grammar: 叙述 takes the course of an event as its object. The quoted account supplies the discovery, search and recovery in order.
note: 课堂 kètáng means class or classroom setting; 经过 jīngguò here means the course of an event.

sentence: 我的检查记录写着：“六只杯子装水十分钟，只有蓝杯杯底滴水。”这表明蓝杯在这次检查中漏水；其他杯子以后会不会漏，还不能确定。
grammar: 表明 links the supplied observation to the limited finding about the blue cup during this check. It does not establish future performance of the other cups.

sentence: 借书表写着：“小安：借两本，还一本；姐姐：借一本，还一本。”这张表显示共借出三本、登记归还两本；没记还书的那本是否真的没还，还得问小安。
grammar: 显示 reports the quantities represented in the supplied record. The missing return entry remains distinct from confirmed nonreturn.
note: 共 gòng means in total.

sentence: 我这周的读书会记录写着：“六人到场，四人发言。”这份记录反映了本次到场和发言的人数，没有记录每个人读了多少书，不能用它评价谁读得最认真。
grammar: 反映 describes the aspect represented by the record: attendance and speaking counts. It does not make the record evidence of reading diligence.
note: 反映 fǎnyìng concerns representation here; 反应 fǎnyìng means a response or reaction.

sentence: 我写的通知是“周六三点在图书馆见”，姐姐指出其中没写具体入口；图书馆有南北两个入口，我补上了“北门”，开始时间没改。
grammar: 指出 introduces the exact omission identified by the sister. The later addition repairs the location detail while preserving the stated time.
note: 北门 běimén means north gate or north entrance.

sentence: 老师先说“今天借的书这周五还”，临走时又强调：“一定是这周五，不是下周五；周六另一组还要用。”我把归还日期写在借书表上。
grammar: 强调 describes reinforcing the already stated return deadline. The repeated distinction between this Friday and next Friday makes the emphasis explicit.
note: 调 is diào in 强调.

sentence: 我在日记里写：“早上我以为一个小时就能装完书，然而两个小时过去了，还有一箱没装；我翻旧照片时耽误了不少时间。”
grammar: 然而 links the initial completion expectation to the contrasting unfinished result.
register: 然而 is common in written accounts; 但是 is a common conversational alternative.
note: The apostrophe separates vowel-initial ér from rán.

sentence: 我请朋友帮忙抬箱子，原以为他搬到门口就走；他帮我搬上三楼，甚至留下来把书也分好放进书柜，我很感谢他。
meaning: even; going so far as to
grammar: 甚至 adds sorting and shelving as a further unexpected level of help beyond carrying the boxes upstairs.
note: 原以为 yuán yǐwéi means originally thought; 感谢 gǎnxiè means thank or feel grateful to.

sentence: 外婆想看看我们最近的照片，特别是弟弟在学校的照片；我给她带了四张弟弟画画、唱歌的照片，也带了两张全家的合照。
grammar: 特别是 singles out the younger brother's school photographs within the broader set of recent family photographs.
note: 全家 quánjiā means the whole family.

sentence: 周末的安排已经大致定了：上午还书，下午去姐姐家；几点见面还没商量，等她今晚下班再确认。
grammar: 大致 limits how fully the arrangements are settled. The activities and parts of the day are decided, but the meeting hour remains open.

sentence: 我们六个人约好六点吃饭、七点看照片；大家都准时来了，六点开饭，只是看照片晚了十分钟，聚会大体上按计划进行。
grammar: 大体上 qualifies conformity to the plan as general rather than complete. The photograph viewing is the stated exception.
note: The final syllable shang is neutral in this selected adverbial reading.

sentence: 三个月前我把字典借给小安，至今还没拿回来；昨天他答应这周五还，我等他带来再借给姐姐。
meaning: up to now; to this day
grammar: 至今 extends the nonreturn from the specified loan three months ago to the present. Friday's return is still only promised.

sentence: 当初我选这间房，是因为离公司近；住了半年，现在仍觉得这个选择合适，每天省下的时间可以陪家人。
grammar: 当初 recalls the circumstances of the original choice from the present perspective. The current assessment is favorable, so regret is not inherent.
note: 省下 shěngxià means save and leave available, here referring to commuting time.

sentence: 我在活动记录里写：“老师刚确认周六三点可以用一楼教室，我随即把这个安排发给组员，大家很快回了消息。”
grammar: 随即 places sending the arrangement immediately after the teacher's confirmation.
register: 随即 is natural in written narration such as this activity record.

sentence: 我在搬家记录里写：“上午十点到十点半，我在楼下帮司机装车；与此同时，姐姐在楼上收拾衣服，十点半才下楼。”
grammar: 与此同时 relates the sister's upstairs activity to the stated downstairs interval. The events overlap rather than form successive steps.
note: 装车 zhuāng chē means load a vehicle.

sentence: 老师给我的留言写着：“周五前交表，地址和电话都要写。”我把两个要点记在本子上：周五前交，地址、电话不能漏；留言没有要求交照片。
